warnings: THE ROOF FRAME IS STEEL, THE FLOORS ARE RC. Every roof member on this view carries steel_section and no main_bar/stirrup, per §6a's rule that a member has one or the other and never both. The only reinforcement anywhere on this view is the 2-ø9 มม. anchor tying each rafter and hip into the concrete beam below.

EVERY MEMBER IS LABELLED ตำแหน่งตามแบบ ('position as drawn') AND NONE IS GIVEN A GRID REFERENCE. The plan draws the hip layout graphically - ridge, four hips, valleys, purlin runs - and dimensions it with roof-geometry figures (0.40 / 0.90 / 0.90 across the ridge, 3.10, 0.90, 1.25, 1.60, 0.15, 0.50) rather than against the column grid. Recording a grid_ref for any of them would mean deciding where a hip crosses a column line by eye, which §4 forbids. They are therefore recorded as one typed entry per member kind with its section and spacing, which is what the sheet actually specifies, and no dummy grid line was added for the roof - see the grid master's own note on this.

2C AND 2-C MEAN A BUILT-UP PAIR OF THE SAME CHANNEL, not a different profile. §6a has no shape for a built-up section, so steel_section records the single C profile and the printed 2C/2-C prefix is preserved in printed_as with a flag on every affected member. A consumer computing steel weight must double these five members.

THE PURLIN'S PROFILE FAMILY IS NOT PRINTED. The sheet writes only แปเหล็ก 25x25x3 มม. with no family letter. A 25x25x3 square profile is a square hollow section, so designation is recorded as SHS and flagged as inferred - §6a lists SHS as a legal family but warns its key mapping is unverified, and this is exactly such a case. The printed string is kept verbatim.

PURLIN SPACING IS A RANGE, @0.32-0.34 ม. Per §0.5 spacing_mm records the smallest (320) and the printed text is kept in spacing_mm_printed_as - the range is real, because the purlins are set out to divide each hip face evenly rather than at a fixed gauge.

TWO RIDGE LEVELS. The main roof ridge is +10.00 ม. and a lower ridge over the rear/side wing is +8.40 ม.; the porch roof (หลังคาไก่ +5.10 ม.) is dimensioned on the left view instead. All three are recorded as level elements so the roof's stepped geometry is not lost.

The word หลังคาไก่ is used on this set for a ridge/gable feature and appears three times at three different levels. Each occurrence is recorded with its own level rather than merged, and the ids are made distinct (หลังคาไก่_อกไก่ / หลังคาไก่_ระดับล่าง) per §0.3's rule that two different things must not share one element_id.
